name: BusBahnBim
author: David Maier
description: Next departures from a Styrian public transport stop (Verbundlinie / BusBahnBim) in the bar, with a departure board and connection search in the popup.

barWidget.description: Next departure from your stop; click for the departure board and connection search

schema.label: Default stop id
schema.description: HAFAS stop id. Changing the stop in the popup overrides this.

schema.label: Lines in the bar
schema.description: Comma-separated, e.g. 1, 7, 63. Empty shows every line.

schema.label: Direction filter
schema.description: Only show departures whose destination contains this text. Empty shows all.
